activity.role: Head Chief of the Big Osage
activity.notes: Pawhuska, also known as White Hair, was the head chief of the Big Osage band. The title/name was later inherited by other Osage leaders, so ATLAS disambiguates this individual as White Hair I. Evidence indicates that he consolidated leadership after Clermont's death around 1795–1796; his death is recorded in 1809. He should not be treated as the sole ruler of every Osage division.

sources.title: Thomas Jefferson to White Hair and Others, 12 July 1804 — Founders Online
sources.citation_text: Founders Online identifies White Hair, or Pawhuska, as head chief of the Big Osage band and notes that he assumed leadership with Pierre Chouteau's support during the 1790s.
